name: How do I choose the right window style for my home's architecture?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right window style for my home's architecture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right window style involves considering your home's architectural period and aesthetic. For example, traditional homes often suit double-hung or casement windows, while modern homes might benefit from large picture windows or sliders. Factors like natural light, ventilation needs, and desired views also play a role. Our team can provide guidance based on your home's design and your personal preferences during a consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Match window style to your home's architecture, considering traditional or modern aesthetics. Also, factor in natural light, ventilation, and desired views.
